# Koala Insulation

> > Koala Insulation provides professional spray foam, blown-in, and batt insulation installation services with energy efficiency solutions for homes and commercial properties across North America.

Koala Insulation is a franchise-based insulation contractor specializing in multiple insulation types, air sealing, and energy-efficient home improvements. The company emphasizes customer testimonials, free estimates, and compliance with modern energy incentive programs like the Inflation Reduction Act.

## Key Topics

- Spray Foam Insulation
- Blown-In Insulation
- Batt Insulation
- Air Sealing
- Crawl Space Encapsulation
- R-value
- Energy Efficiency
- Thermal Imaging
- Vapor Barrier
- Solar Attic Fans
- Commercial Insulation
- Moisture Control
- Tax Credits (IRA)
- Free Estimates
- HVAC

## Core Services

- [Energy-Efficient Insulation Solutions | Koala Insulation](https://koalainsulation.com/services): Overview of all insulation services including spray foam, air sealing, and crawl space encapsulation.
- [Spray Foam Insulation - Installation & Consultation](https://koalainsulation.com/services/spray-foam-insulation): Detailed service page for spray foam insulation with open-cell and closed-cell options.
- [Professional Blown-In Insulation Services](https://koalainsulation.com/services/blown-in-attic-insulation): Service page for blown-in cellulose, fiberglass, and mineral wool insulation installation.
- [Batt Insulation Services - Installation and Consultation](https://koalainsulation.com/services/batt-insulation-installation): Service page for fiberglass and mineral wool batt insulation installation and benefits.
- [Commercial & Home Air Sealing Services](https://koalainsulation.com/services/air-sealing-service): Service page for air sealing using thermal imaging to reduce energy waste.
- [Crawl Space Encapsulation Services - Koala Insulation](https://koalainsulation.com/services/crawl-space-encapsulation): Service page for crawl space encapsulation with moisture control and mold prevention.
